summary: All two candidates checked. Agricultural 94/60 exactly duplicates inherited text and citation. The human-beating clause at 112/16 is a plausible ḥny II extension but not securely attributable; it is withheld from the published sense list rather than treated as established homonymy or a forced new sense.

Permitted lookup: form mḥannanne offers ḥny and mḥy 1 among candidates; mḥy 1 I has mḥele/moḥe and schlagen, with inflected contractions. This does not prove that the token belongs there either. Etymological “strike/hit” in the ḥny head is not synchronic corpus evidence.

112/16: determine whether mḥannanne is ḥny II or irregular mḥy 1, and segment the agent/patient suffixes; clarify whether lag gawraṯṯe is an agent phrase or a resumed/duplicated l-series argument. Could not determine from the supplied verse and existing paradigms.

94/60: confirm 1pl agent and plural-object segmentation of mḥánnanne. If 112/16 is confirmed as ḥny II, append a new sense 2 for schlagen/prügeln; do not place it before or renumber agricultural sense 1.
